sections.title: How things look
sections.text: You are doing fine. January will be a little tight because your TV licence is due, but you are ready for it.

sections.title: Last month
sections.text: In December, £2,040 came in because you had two pension payments. Your biggest bills were rent (£480), council tax (£118) and gas (£86). You took out £160 in cash, and you had £990 left over.

sections.title: The next three months
sections.text: January looks tight, with about £15 spare, mainly because your TV licence of £175 is due. February looks fine, with about £348 spare. March also looks fine, with about £348 spare.

sections.title: One idea
sections.text: Keep adding £20 a month to your heating pot, just as you agreed with Priya. It is your choice. Free, independent help is available from MoneyHelper and Citizens Advice.

sections.title: Scam watch
sections.text: Nothing unusual this month. Your payments all look like your normal ones. We will never ask for your details in a letter. If someone calls and asks you for money, put the phone down and use the number on the back of your bank card.

sections.title: Since your last visit
sections.text: Priya agreed with you: set up heating pot, £20 a month.

sections.title: Ask a question
sections.text: If you have a question, tick a box on the slip or ask your helper on Tuesday. Priya or a colleague will reply by letter.
